data_objects.name: station_temperature_observations
data_objects.meaning: Dated weather-station observations containing an observation type and paired temperature representations.
data_objects.notes: The compact and ISO date fields represent the same observation date in different encodings.

variables.name: datetime
variables.meaning: Observation date encoded as YYYYMMDD digits.

variables.name: obs_type
variables.meaning: Observation-type code; TMAX denotes maximum temperature in the visible records.

variables.name: obs_value
variables.meaning: Temperature observation expressed on the Celsius scale.

variables.name: TMAX_F
variables.meaning: Maximum-temperature value expressed on the Fahrenheit scale.

variables.name: datetime_dt
variables.meaning: Observation date encoded in ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

structure.description: Each row represents a station-date-observation-type record, identified by the combination of station, datetime, and obs_type.
datetime and datetime_dt are alternate encodings of the same date; obs_value and TMAX_F are Celsius and Fahrenheit representations of the temperature for TMAX records.

uncertainties: Station locations, source network, and observation protocol are not supplied.
The table does not document whether observation types other than TMAX are permitted in the broader source.
annotation_notes: The temperature units are supported by the numerical Celsius-to-Fahrenheit relationship visible in train.csv.
